name: Gardener
text: On Recruit: +1 of each color you have none of. Round Start: +1 of each color you have none of.

name: Customs
text: Whenever a rival steals or changes any of your resources, +1 yellow.

name: Tinker
text: On Recruit: swap up to 3 of your resources one for one. Round Start: swap up to 3 of your resources one for one.

name: Harmonist
text: Game End: +1 follower per full set you hold.

name: Matchmaker
text: Whenever you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 in colors you choose and +1 follower.

name: Agitator
text: On Recruit: change up to 4 of rivals' resources one for one.

name: Ringleader
text: On Recruit: change 1 of each rival's resources one for one. +1 follower per rival changed.

name: Drifters
text: Worth 2 followers. On Recruit: choose a color; these count as a member of that color.

name: Leveler
text: On Use, once per round: choose a color; 1 of each rival's biggest color becomes it.

name: Big Tent
text: Game End: +2 followers per color you have exactly one member of.

name: Guest Book
text: Whenever you recruit a member of a color none of your members have, +2 yellow.

name: Gleaner
text: Whenever an action gains you 2 or more of another color at once, +1 yellow.

name: Sower
text: Round Start: plant any of your yellow. Round End: gain that many of each other color.

name: Silversmith
text: Whenever a rival takes a Silver space, +1 silver.

name: Steward
text: On Recruit: +1 silver per 3 silver you hold. Round Start: +1 silver per 3 silver you hold.

name: Toastmaster
text: Whenever you take a Silver space, +1 follower.

name: Dowager
text: Worth 3 followers.

name: Smooth Talker
text: Your silver pays for any color.

name: Philanthropists
text: On Recruit: rivals gain up to 4 silver, split as you choose. +1 follower for each.

name: Polisher
text: On Use, once per game: turn up to 3 silver into 2 of any colors each.

name: Collector
text: Whenever a rival recruits paying silver, +1 silver.

name: Debt Collector
text: On Use, once per game: each rival gives you 2 silver, if they have it.

name: High Society
text: Game End: +2 followers per rival with more silver than you.

name: Big Family
text: Worth 4 followers.

name: Makeover
text: On Recruit: send the whole shop to the bottom of the pile, then refill.

name: Bulk Buyer
text: Whenever you buy 5 or more followers, +1 follower.

name: Shareholder
text: Worth 3 followers.

name: Choir
text: Whenever you copy a space, +1 green.

name: Gift Wrapper
text: Whenever you give rivals silver, +1 follower.

name: Caravan
text: Worth 3 followers. On Recruit: +1 of each color you hold. Round Start: +1 of each color you hold.

name: Tastemaker
text: Whenever you change rivals' resources, +1 follower.

name: Spice Route
text: Game End: +1 follower per color you hold 3 or more of.

name: Line Cutters
text: You go first every round.
